verdict.rationale: For a GPU, headless or CI use means running compute workloads without a display. The CUDA toolkit docs point that way: CUDA containers are distributed via NGC, and applications can be deployed on data centers and cloud platforms. The evidence never says this applies to the GeForce RTX 5070 Ti specifically, and most of the pack covers display-centric gaming and creator features. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of headless (no-display) operation for this consumer card, CI/container runtime guidance tied to GeForce cards, any hands-on or community report of running it in CI or automation.
